text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since her debut race.
One day――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My! There is a special feature article
on Miss Scarlet here as well!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*~, tell me about it. Everywhere you look, it's Scarlet this and Vodka that.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The latest news! The genius magical girl Sweepy
is skipping grades and making big waves, right~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, calm down...
Selfish children get a *bonk*, you know!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! Scarlet-san!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I saw it! The special feature article!
Namely, 'The Queens of the Future'!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san comes first! And next is...
Scarlet-san, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that just means coming in second, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you dissatisfied?
I would think your abilities are sufficiently recognized, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry!
How could I say that to an upperclassman...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, don't worry about it. Gracious at all times—
that is what makes an elegant princess, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, you ought to take more pride in yourself.
After all, you possess something truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I feel absolutely terrible.
......All because of her.
choice_data_list: Whose fault is it that everything's the worst?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, that's not true!!
I would never use language like that—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it's just you. Hmph, don't scare me like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? It's Vodka.
Everyone's making a big fuss about her being number one, and only her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She is seriously such a nuisance!!
Because of her, everything's ruined!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious why?!
Because you took 1st place from me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If I become number one, everyone will praise me!
*Everyone* will say, "As expected, she's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Getting second place totally changes everything, though.
It turns into, "You worked hard, so close!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't want comforting words.
I want words of praise... for me, and only me."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? Are you stupid!?
I never told you to say something like that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... What I was trying to say was,
put some more spirit into it!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"If I achieve the best result in the Classics,
everyone's perception of me is bound to change in an instant."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why you cannot afford to let your guard down during the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Polish my running, polish it, and polish it to perfection...
Gain the strength worthy of being number one. And then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We're going to take first place and kick off the Classics in style!
